thread:
Maya: heads-up — ACME corp reporting repeated 502/504s on hosted /v1/generate-stream (us-west1) starting ~09:58 UTC. Streaming sessions cut mid-chunk, clients see 'connection reset' and SDK retries. Repro provided below.

Alex: @Maya grabbing req ids and traces. Any sample request ids or curl?

Maya: sample req id: rQ7f2a0-58. Repro (sanitized):
```bash
curl -i -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -d '{"model":"gptx", "stream": true, "input":"<long prompt>"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate-stream
```

deploy-bot: rollout/edge-proxy-config-2026-03-18 completed by ops@deploy at 09:55 UTC :rocket:

Sofia: @Alex I'm seeing elevated `chunk_write_timeout` errors from the edge to runtime at 09:55-10:05 in us-west1. Also some 502s correlate with connection termination mid-send. Pushing traces.

Alex: logs for req rQ7f2a0-58: edge -> upstream RST_STREAM, http2 code 0x2. No obvious runtime OOM. Attaching snippet:
```log
[09:56:01] edge: send chunk id=37 size=12 err=EPIPE
[09:56:01] upstream: conn reset by peer
```

Marcus: looks like edge stopped sending because backpressure queue reached threshold after a big chunk. Did the recent proxy rollout change chunked write batching? @Sofia

Sofia: yes, the rollout toggled `enable_chunk_coalesce=true` to try to reduce small writes. It may interact poorly with streaming keepalive / h2 window settings. Reversing now.

Priya: ACME says after disabling retries in their SDK they still saw some single session drops but far fewer 5xx. They want ETA and whether they were double-billed.

Alex: billing team's separate — I'll flag billing but preliminary usage logs show retries counted as separate requests; we'll confirm if credit/refund needed.

Sofia: rollback started 10:12 UTC -> deploying rollback patch to edge-proxy config. Monitoring.

Maya: FYI customer noticed improvement around 10:25 UTC — fewer 502s, stream completes. They still want an RCA.

Marcus: we rolled back config fully at 10:30 UTC. Post-rollback metrics: 5xx rate in us-west1 normalized to baseline by 10:35. Leaving monitoring on for 2h.

Alex: action items: 1) compile timeline and logs for RCA (I'll own) 2) verify billing counts and coordinate refunds if duplicate charges (I'll ping finance) 3) add e2e test for chunked streaming + coalesce flag (Marcus/Sofia) 4) follow up with ACME and close out.

Priya: I'll send ACME an interim note: 'We've rolled back a proxy change that likely caused streaming drops; we observed improvement and will share RCA in 24h.'

Maya: ACME replied :white_check_mark: 'streams working, thanks — please keep us posted.'

Alex: opening incident INC-2026-0423 and assigning eng-runtime. Tagging eng-oncall for postmortem.

Marcus: quick root-cause hypothesis: chunk coalescing + aggressive h2 write window + short keepalive => large combined payload hitting run-time write path causing backpressure -> edge drops. Plan: revert default flag, add better backpressure metrics, and add safety cap.

Sofia: will revert flag by default and add a canary with toggled timeouts.

deploy-bot: rollback/edge-proxy-config-2026-03-18 completed by ops@deploy at 10:30 UTC :white_check_mark:

Alex: thanks everyone. Closing thread for now; will repost RCA doc link when ready.
